answer: In a freelance incident-repair network, Sybil agents grab tickets and then stall. Each accepted job must stream a live heartbeat pulse signed by the customer's canary: an incrementing repair-trace rooted in that team's deploy trellis, a Merkle of allowed change windows and service IDs. Only traces inside the live window keep the bond. Peers recompute the Merkle path and check pulse timestamps; a gap over 40 seconds slashes the stake. It fails if the canary is just an echo of a recorded fixture played from one laptop, so many fake agents can share that recording and still look live.
